three-card.name: Past, Present, Future
three-card.provenance: Position descriptions from A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot (1911).

positions.label: Past
positions.description: It gives the influence that is just passed, or is now passing away.

positions.label: Present
positions.description: This card gives the influence which is affecting the person or matter of inquiry generally, the atmosphere of it in which the other currents work.

positions.label: Future
positions.description: It shews the influence that is coming into action and will operate in the near future.

celtic-cross.name: Celtic Cross
celtic-cross.provenance: A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot (1911), Part III section 7, 'An Ancient Celtic Method of Divination'. Labels and descriptions are his.

positions.label: That covers him
positions.description: This card gives the influence which is affecting the person or matter of inquiry generally, the atmosphere of it in which the other currents work.

positions.label: What crosses him
positions.description: It shews the nature of the obstacles in the matter. If it is a favourable card, the opposing forces will not be serious, or it may indicate that something good in itself will not be productive of good in the particular connexion.

positions.label: What crowns him
positions.description: It represents (a) the Querent's aim or ideal in the matter; (b) the best that can be achieved under the circumstances, but that which has not yet been made actual.

positions.label: What is beneath him
positions.description: It shews the foundation or basis of the matter, that which has already passed into actuality and which the Significator has made his own.

positions.label: What is behind him
positions.description: It gives the influence that is just passed, or is now passing away.

positions.label: What is before him
positions.description: It shews the influence that is coming into action and will operate in the near future.

positions.label: Himself
positions.description: The first of these, or the SEVENTH CARD of the operation, signifies himself—that is, the Significator—whether person or thing-and shews its position or attitude in the circumstances.

positions.label: His house
positions.description: The EIGHTH CARD signifies his house, that is, his environment and the tendencies at work therein which have an effect on the matter—for instance, his position in life, the influence of immediate friends, and so forth.

positions.label: His hopes or fears
positions.description: The NINTH CARD gives his hopes or fears in the matter.

positions.label: What will come
positions.description: The TENTH is what will come, the final result, the culmination which is brought about by the influences shewn by the other cards that have been turned up in the divination.

ranks.knight: a man of forty years old and upward
ranks.king: any male who is under that age
ranks.queen: a woman who is over forty years

suits.wands: very fair people, with yellow or auburn hair, fair complexion and blue eyes
suits.cups: people with light brown or dull fair hair and grey or blue eyes
suits.swords: people having hazel or grey eyes, dark brown hair and dull complexion
suits.pentacles: persons with very dark brown or black hair, dark eyes and sallow or swarthy complexions
